notes: JuryToken is a fixed-supply ERC-20 named JURY with symbol JURY and 18 decimals. Its constructor takes no arguments and mints all 1,000,000,000 tokens once to msg.sender, the launch factory. It has no owner, further minting, privileged controls or transfer fees. There are no application contracts. The pool pairs with IMD. initialPrice records provenance only; the deployer derives the opening price from initialMarketCapWei and totalSupply.
